chunks: Draw logic gate symbols. The question: Draw a NOT/AND/etc gate symbol.
A logic gate is a tiny circuit with one or two inputs, each 0 or 1, and one output that follows a fixed rule.
Each rule has its own drawn symbol, so an engineer can read a circuit diagram at a glance.
This question asks you to sketch the standard ones: NOT, AND, OR, NAND, NOR, XOR and XNOR.
Think of road signs. You don't read a sign, you recognize its shape. Gate symbols work the same way. A small circle on a symbol, called a bubble, means "flip the answer".
So the family is a few base shapes plus an optional bubble.
The one-input gates. The buffer is the bare triangle. Adding the bubble at the tip turns it into the inverter. Everything that follows reuses that same bubble.
NOT: the output is the opposite of the input. It is a triangle with a bubble. AND: the output is 1 only if all inputs are 1. It is a flat-backed "D" shape.
OR: the output is 1 if at least one input is 1. It has a curved back and a pointed front. Bubble: the small circle that inverts a signal.
A bubble on the output of AND makes NAND, on OR makes NOR, and on XOR makes XNOR. XOR: the output is 1 when the two inputs differ.
It is an OR with one extra curved line behind it.
Draw an AND gate: a flat back, a round front, two input wires on the left, one output on the right. With A = 1 and B = 1, the output is 1. With A = 1 and B = 0, the output is 0.
Add a bubble on the output tip and you have a NAND, which gives the opposite answers: 0 and 1. That is the whole idea: a few shapes plus a bubble cover the family.
"I draw inputs on the left, output on the right. A triangle is a buffer, and a triangle with a bubble is NOT. AND is a D shape, OR is the curved-back shield shape.
Add a bubble on the output of those and you get NAND and NOR. XOR is OR with an extra curved line at the back, XNOR adds a bubble. The bubble always means inversion.
I'd write the expression next to each one: A·B, A+B, A⊕B. And the symbol only tells you the function, not how it's built."
Quick check. Which symbol is a NOR gate?
